summary.text: Bill Galvin is a Democratic member of the Massachusetts House of Representatives for the 6th Norfolk District, which includes Avon, Canton and parts of Stoughton, and has served in the House since 1991.
The Legislature's committee listing shows him as Chair of the House Committee on Rules and of the Joint Committee on Rules.

paragraphs.text: William C. Galvin's official biography says he is serving his 10th term as a state representative and lists his profession as insurance broker.
It says he is co-owner and operator of a family-run insurance agency in Canton, where he lives with his wife and two children.
His listed education is Canton High School, Framingham State College and Suffolk University.
His public service is listed as the Canton Board of Library Trustees from 1979 to 1987 and the Canton Board of Assessors from 1987 to the present, followed by the Massachusetts House from 1991.

The biography lists his career highlights as becoming Chair of the House Committee on Personnel and Administration in March 2009, long-term membership on House Ways and Means, and service as vice chair of the Joint Committee on Insurance and the Joint Committee on Children, Families and Persons with Disabilities.
